scope: Static original rtSym metadata, SCP call-shaped candidates, application functions, and external declarations.
descriptor_note: Descriptors beginning with an untyped underscore symbol, such as _bbAbs, are retained as internal_runtime_symbol with unknown callable signature; they are not exposed Blitz command signatures.
identifier_evidence_rule: Case-insensitive token occurrence after BASIC comments and strings are blanked; not call resolution.
call_candidate_rule: Call-shaped identifiers followed by '(' or a statement-shaped identifier after a small set of BASIC statement prefixes. These candidates are not resolved parser/binder callsites; arrays and ambiguous statements may be included.
status_rule: A syntactic candidate mapped to a parsed .decls row is externaldependency unless shadowed by an app Function. Native statuses come from the explicit support map below; language intrinsics are listed separately. No status is inferred from original registration or lexical mention alone.

compiler_intrinsics.name: Abs
compiler_intrinsics.evidence: Parsed as a unary language token and emitted through __BlitzAbs; this is not an external native call.

compiler_intrinsics.name: Sgn
compiler_intrinsics.evidence: Parsed as a unary language token and emitted through __BlitzSgn; this is not an external native call.

filesize.scope: Core behavior, NUL truncation, missing directory, and unique wildcard cases verified by native-first tests; ordering for multiple wildcard matches and host Unicode differences remain unverified.

filetype.scope: Core behavior, NUL truncation, missing directory, and unique wildcard cases verified by native-first tests; ordering for multiple wildcard matches and host Unicode differences remain unverified.

currentdir.scope: Core behavior verified by native-first tests; wildcard ordering and host Unicode differences remain unverified.

getenv.scope: Core behavior and NUL truncation verified by native-first tests.

chr.scope: Native capture verified ASCII and CP1252 low-byte behavior; unrepresentable Unicode input raises an explicit encoding error.

len.scope: Native capture verified byte count for ASCII and CP1252; unrepresentable Unicode input raises an explicit encoding error.

runtimeerror.scope: Existing implementation reported by parent agent.

dependency_evidence.evidence: Source-backed: original bbruntime/bbfilesystem.cpp uses gx_filesys for these operations; filesystem_create obtains it from gx_runtime->openFileSystem(0); bbruntime_link calls filesystem_link.
Source-backed: original bbruntime/bbruntime.cpp implements GetEnv using getenv and SetEnv using putenv.
Source-backed current implementation: LegacyStrings uses the .NET code pages provider to encode and decode CP1252 bytes; these commands have no app .decls dependency.
